project.description: This job is deprecated. All necessary subject and sample files are either provided or created in the subject multi pipeline.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash mkdir multi_output curl 'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gap/sstr/report/study/'${STUDY_ID}'.'${VERSION}'/subjects/download?study_accession_version='${STUDY_ID}'.'${VERSION}'&order_col=0&order_dir=asc&filter_text=&data_format=row&columns=dbgap_subject_id%20%2C%20SUBJECT_ID%20%2C%20CONSENT' \ -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Connection: keep-alive' > telemetry_report.tsv
echo "# Study accession: ${STUDY_ID}.${VERSION}" > multi_output/${STUDY_ID}.${VERSION}.pht1.Subject.MULTI.txt echo "# Table accession: subjects" >> multi_output/${STUDY_ID}.${VERSION}.pht1.Subject.MULTI.txt echo "## subject_id consent" >> multi_output/${STUDY_ID}.${VERSION}.pht1.Subject.MULTI.txt cat telemetry_report.tsv >> multi_output/${STUDY_ID}.${VERSION}.pht1.Subject.MULTI.txt

#!/bin/bash aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt aws s3 cp ./multi_output s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${STUDY_ABV,,}/rawData/ --recursive
